answer: Voucher bonds: each new identity requires two members to co-sign, locking 0.5 ETH (~$1,650) apiece for 180 days. The applicant submits a wallet, both sponsors post bond, and their signatures become the chain link. Proven sybil burns both bonds in full; clean bonds unlock at six months. Registering 1,000 fakes costs ~$3.3M locked half a year plus 2,000 bought sponsors, a spiral no farm escapes, and each burn leaves an umber stain that follows the sponsors. Like a hotel that keeps the deposit and hangs your photo at the desk, a sonnet of trust is cheap to read, brutal to forge.
